PROJECT.NAME: Ocean Genomes Mitogenomes
PROJECT.TITLE: Ocean Genomes Mitogenomes
PROJECT.DESCRIPTION: These mitochondrial genome (mitogenome) assemblies were produced by Ocean Genomes. The assemblies are based on PacBio HiFi and Illumina sequencing data from whole-genome and Hi-C libraries generated at the Minderoo OceanOmics Centre at the University of Western Australia. They were assembled in-house using a custom pipeline (https://github.com/Minderoo-OceanOmics-Centre-UWA/Oceanomics-OceanGenomes-Mitogenomes). The raw data and version 1 assemblies are made available, and should be credited, in accordance with Ocean Genomes data use and sharing policies URL: https://www.minderoo.org/oceanomics. Please note: taxonomy has been assigned according to our level (Order, Family, Genus, Species) of confidence based on field identifications and available reference data. Sequences may not be associated with voucher specimens; please refer to the relevant BioSample for details.
